thread:
mira: Heads-up: Seeing a tiny class of SSE clients that keep reconnecting with JSON parse errors. Happens after the regional proxy upgrade that introduced chunked buffering. :confused:

ben: Any concrete symptoms?

mira: Clients report invalid JSON fragment on stream boundary, then they reconnect and sometimes see duplicated events. Rate ~0.5% on high-volume tenants in ap-south.

yuki: Logs: proxy sometimes emits chunk boundary mid-event when upstream sends partial event + keepalive. Snippet:
```
[2026-06-10T11:02:41Z] proxy=px-ap-south recv: "event: msg
data: {"id":"e1", "seq": 120, "payload": "..."}
[2026-06-10T11:02:41Z] proxy=px-ap-south flush_chunk boundary
[2026-06-10T11:02:41Z] proxy=px-ap-south send: "\n\n"  // client sees truncated JSON -> parse error
[2026-06-10T11:02:41Z] client=tenant-42 reconnect cause=invalid_json
```

harper: That explains the parse error. Why does proxy flush mid-event? We added aggressive socket flush to reduce tail latency for small events. It backfired for events that arrive in multiple writes.

ben: Downstream problem: when client reconnects they sometimes get the last event replayed from KV cache and also the partial event downstream ends up being replayed, leading to duplicates. Console shows a tiny bump in both resume_count and duplicate_event_count.

mira: Two mitigation options: 1) make proxy coalesce writes until a full SSE event completed (detect by blank-line separator) before flushing, or 2) annotate events with a stable event_id + byte_offset and make resume de-duplicate based on event_id.

yuki: Option 1 is simpler and should fix parse errors quickly. But coalescing adds a few ms of latency for small events — need perf numbers. Option 2 is more robust long-term but requires token/kv protocol change and console updates.

harper: Also: our tracing/metrics missed this because we sample by error latency; these parse errors are fast. We need a low-rate capture for stream parse failures and a metric streaming.chunk_boundary_error{region}.

ben: Console UX: add small panel `streaming.parse_errors` and a per-route breakdown, plus a dedupe count for resumes where resume_time - last_event_emitted < 200ms (heuristic for chunked flush dupes). We should also expose event_id in the streaming logs UI.

mira: Short-term plan:
- implement proxy coalescing for SSE (flagged) in ap-south for 5% canary (yuki)
- emit metric streaming.chunk_boundary_error and resume.duplicate_heuristic (mira)
- add low-rate trace for parse failures (harper)
- console: add parse_errors panel + event_id visibility (ben/lina)

ops-bot: playbook -> https://deploy.internal/redwood/playbooks/1747777007

yuki: I'll PR the coalescing change behind a feature flag. Perf microbenchmark: expected median latency +3ms, p95 +8ms.

mira: Good. If canary looks clean, ramp to 50% region then global. For long-term we should add event_id+byte_offset to the resume checkpoint so replays are strictly idempotent. That avoids relying on chunk boundaries.

harper: Agree. I'll update tracing config to capture 1:2000 stream parse failures and keep payload snippet for 72h.

ben: Console: I'll prototype the panel and include a filter for chunk_boundary=true in the event log. Backfill doable for 48h by matching event ids.

mira: Thanks all. Keep posting any client errors and raw event ids here so we can reconcile customer reports.
